theater: 北印度德里與勒克瑙戰線

battle.name: 印度民族起義
battle.theater: 北印度德里與勒克瑙戰線
battle.brief: 一八五七年五月十日，密拉特軍營起事，起義軍攻入德里並擁立巴合杜爾沙為帝。德里的雷管步槍多來自公司軍械庫與法造步槍，射擊精準但裝填遲緩，攻城仰賴繳獲的火砲與夜襲；同年下半年戰線東移勒克瑙、坎伯而與占西，終被英軍攻城砲列與刺刀攻城的立體火力壓垮。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 英方是東印度公司統治下的印度，兵權分屬孟加拉軍、馬德拉斯軍、孟買軍三大軍區，另有旁遮普軍團與旁遮普遊擊隊，經費由總督府直接撥付。孟加拉軍是起義的重心：全軍分英籍部隊與印度籍土兵兩類，印籍團沿用舊營制，每營分為三個分營，各由一名蘇巴達率領，分營之下設連與排，團長由英籍上校出任，印度籍最多升到副官。英方最高指揮為總督查爾斯·坎寧與英軍總司令科林·坎貝爾，第五師、第六師分別負責勒克瑙與德里的戰線，休·羅斯率中央印度野戰軍自南方北上，威廉·戈姆統率孟加拉軍主力，阿奇博爾德·坎貝爾負責攻取紅城，約翰·勞倫斯坐鎮旁遮普。叛方沒有國家，只有鬆散的聯盟：德里的莫臥兒朝廷以八十二歲的巴合杜爾沙為名，實權落在砲兵將軍貝赫特汗手上；坎伯而一帶是馬拉塔派的納那·薩希卜與坦提亞·托佩；勒克瑙是奧德王太后貝戈姆·哈茲拉特·馬哈爾與其子哈西卜丁·阿里汗；比哈爾有昆瓦爾·辛格；占西有拉尼·拉克什米拜；旁遮普與德里還有土邦領主率領的武裝以及民兵式的城鄉義軍。
countriesEn: The British side was British India under the East India Company, with military power divided among the three Presidency armies of Bengal, Madras and Bombay, together with the Punjab Corps and the Punjab Irregular Force, all paid for by the Governor-General's government. Bengal was the centre of gravity: the army was composed of European regiments and Indian sepoys, the native regiments keeping the old battalion system, each battalion divided into three sub-divisions, each sub-division led by a subedar, with companies and sections below, an English colonel commanding the regiment and Indians rising no higher than subedar. The British high command was Governor-General Charles Canning together with Commander-in-Chief Colin Campbell; the 5th and 6th Divisions respectively held the Lucknow and Delhi fronts, Hugh Rose led the Central India Field Force northward from the south, William Gomm commanded the main body of the Bengal Army, Archibald Campbell was given the assault on Delhi, and John Lawrence held the Punjab. The insurgents had no state, only a loose alliance: a Mughal court at Delhi around the eighty-two-year-old Bahadur Shah with real power in the hands of the artillery general Bakht Khan; the Maratha party of Nana Sahib and Tantia Tope at Cawnpore; at Lucknow the Begum Hazrat Mahal of Awadh and her son Hasiuddin Ali Khan; in Bihar Kunwar Singh; at Jhansi Rani Lakshmibai; and in Punjab and Delhi risings by local princes and landowners together with town and village militias of the militia kind.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩邊。英方有總督查爾斯·坎寧，他主持全局但不直接領兵；科林·坎貝爾自一八五七年秋接任英軍總司令，主導勒克瑙解圍；休·羅斯指揮中央印度野戰軍，於一八五八年攻克勒克瑙、坎伯而與占西；阿奇博爾德·坎貝爾統率攻德里的縱隊，於九月十四日奪回紅城；威廉·戈姆在勒克瑙第二次解圍前夕拒絕出兵，成為日後最受爭議的決定；約翰·勞倫斯在旁遮普招募遊擊隊守土，抵禦北上的起義軍。叛方人數眾多而分散：孟加拉軍第三十四團的士官曼加爾·潘迪於一八五七年三月二十九日在巴拉克普爾抗拒新式藥包，四月八日被處絞刑，成為起義的象徵；密拉特起事後，德里推舉巴合杜爾沙為帝，貝赫特汗以砲兵將軍身分掌軍，他拒絕稱王，只願以攝政自居；坎伯而的納那·薩希卜以培吉拉家族養子的身分號召馬拉塔舊部，坦提亞·托佩任其參謀，擅長騎兵游擊，阿齊姆·拉赫曼汗以達羅毗荼王朝末裔身分出使各地遊說；勒克瑙的貝戈姆·哈茲拉特·馬哈爾為幼子戴上記號，與兄弟及以毛拉維·艾哈邁杜拉沙為首的義軍將領死守到底；比哈爾八十歲的昆瓦爾·辛格帶兩個兒子阿馬爾·辛格與拉古納特·辛格作戰至一八五八年十一月傷重；占西的拉尼·拉克什米拜收養達莫達·拉奧，與坦提亞·托佩並肩，最終戰歿。
peopleEn: Key figures fall on both sides. On the British side Governor-General Charles Canning directed policy without taking the field; Colin Campbell became Commander-in-Chief in the autumn of 1857 and led the relief of Lucknow; Hugh Rose commanded the Central India Field Force that took Lucknow, Cawnpore and Jhansi in 1858; Archibald Campbell led the columns that stormed Delhi on 14 September; William Gomm's refusal to march to Lucknow before the second relief remains the most disputed decision of the campaign; John Lawrence held the Punjab with locally raised irregulars against the advancing rebels. On the insurgent side, with leaders scattered across the whole north: Mangal Pandey, a sepoy of the 34th Bengal Native Infantry, resisted the new cartridges at Barrackpore on 29 March 1857 and was hanged on 8 April, becoming the emblem of the rising; after Meerut the Delhi sepoys proclaimed Bahadur Shah emperor, while Bakht Khan, an artilleryman by training, took the command and refused the imperial title, preferring to act as regent; at Cawnpore Nana Sahib, adopted heir of the Peshwa family, called on the old Maratha networks, Tantia Tope served as his adviser and master of cavalry raiding, and Azimullah Khan, descended from the last southern line, travelled as an emissary; at Lucknow Begum Hazrat Mahal had her young son invested with princely titles and held out with her brothers and with the volunteers under Moulvi Ahmadullah Shah; in Bihar the eighty-year-old Kunwar Singh fought on with his sons Amar Singh and Raghunath Singh until mortally wounded in November 1858; at Jhansi Rani Lakshmibai, with her adopted son Damodar Rao, fought beside Tantia Tope and was killed in the end.
kits: 卡面這支法製雷管步槍是本場戰爭的底色。法國在一八三〇年代末至一八四〇年代初把制式步槍全面改為雷管擊發，一八四〇年式與其後的一八四九年式前膛步槍口徑十四點七毫米，以紙殼定量藥包配圓形彈丸，結構耐用、成本低於英國產品，在歐洲大量外銷；東印度公司自一八四〇年代起從法國與比利時等地採購，一八五〇年代中期一批訂單即達上萬支，與倫敦恩菲爾德兵工廠的一八四二式、一八五三式步槍同時在印度軍中服役。叛軍手中的雷管步槍幾乎全靠繳獲：六月初阿拉哈巴德軍械庫淪陷，起義軍取走約八千支步槍、上百門火炮與大批火藥，成為北方戰線的主要來源；德里與勒克瑙的儲備同樣被奪。但型號與口徑混雜，紙殼藥包的規格彼此不合，前線常出現有槍無藥或被迫改用他型藥包的窘境，制式槍的精度因此打了折扣。英軍則靠一八五三年式步槍的定量化藥包、海運與鐵路維持精度與續航，該型槍為 .577 吋口徑、配銅殼錐形彈，另有線膛槍與舊式雷管步槍。攻城方面，叛軍把繳獲的野砲拉到城牆與要道，曾在德里城北的巴德利堡壘與英軍砲隊對射；英軍以二十四磅砲、九磅與八吋攻城砲組成砲壘，並由皇家海軍的康格里夫火箭支援。輕武器除制式槍外，還有印度本地匠人仿製的蘭伯式滑膛火槍與舊式燧發槍，以及大量彎刀、小盾與長矛。
kitsEn: The French percussion rifle on the card is the background colour of this war. France converted service muskets to percussion ignition in the late 1830s and early 1840s, and the model of 1840 with its successor of 1849 used a 14.7 mm calibre, a paper cartridge with a round ball, were rugged, cheap by British standards and were exported across Europe in large numbers; the East India Company began buying in France and Belgium from the 1840s, and a single mid-1850s order ran to well over ten thousand, so these rifles served side by side with the Enfield patterns of 1842 and 1853 in India. Almost every percussion rifle the insurgents used was captured: when the Allahabad arsenal fell in early June they carried off some eight thousand muskets, more than a hundred guns and large stocks of ammunition, which became the main supply of the northern front, and the stores at Delhi and Lucknow were seized as well. But the mixture of patterns and calibres meant the paper cartridges did not always match, ammunition was often unobtainable, and the accuracy of service rifles was degraded accordingly. The British preserved accuracy and endurance with the fixed ammunition of the 1853 pattern, a .577 calibre rifle taking a copper-cased conical ball, backed by sea transport and the railway, and also had rifled arms and older percussion muskets in the line. For siege work the rebels dragged captured field guns to the walls and key roads and once fought the British batteries from Badli Bagh north of Delhi; the British answered with 24-pounder guns, 9-pounder and 8-inch siege howitzers organised in batteries, supported by Congreve rockets from the Royal Navy. Alongside the service rifles there were Indian-made smoothbores in the lambe pattern, old flint muskets, and a great many talwars, bucklers and spears.
tactics: 起義軍的戰術帶著軍營起事的痕跡：先解除友軍的武裝、奪取軍械庫與火藥庫，再以整隊行軍去攻擊英軍據點。密拉特的起義軍連夜行軍約四十公里，十一日進抵德里，隨即猛攻城門、紅城與軍械庫。守住紅城之後，叛軍以城牆、壕溝與舊砲壘為依托，把英軍騎兵逐出城郊，卻沒有能力封鎖城外的道路，也沒有穩定的補給線。英軍的對策是圍城：六月八日完成對德里的包圍，在城外構築砲壘，以二十四磅砲、八吋與九吋攻城砲轟擊城牆與城內目標，並封鎖交通，企圖以砲火與封鎖逼降。叛軍在城北巴德利堡壘佈置野砲反擊，其中一門長身管砲曾自遠處命中英軍砲壘，砲身與射程在雙方軍史中記錄並不一致。直到九月十四日，英軍才以主縱隊、第二縱隊與第三縱隊同時攻入紅城，縱隊在狹窄街巷中以線形射擊、刺刀突進與逐屋清剿逐段爭奪，攻城部隊約三千七百人，攻方傷亡逾一千一百人。坎伯而的戰鬥是叛軍最有效的一次砲兵奇襲：七月五日，起義軍夜間以砲火覆蓋英軍營地，瓦解惠勒少校以七十四門砲構成的壕溝陣地，守軍在騎兵掩護下收復營地；同樣的招數後來被英軍用來對付占西，休·羅斯的中央印度野戰軍以攻城砲列壓制城牆，四月占西陷落，守軍因城門被內應開啟而崩潰。勒克瑙的守軍則示範了另一種打法：以總督官邸為核心築壘，與城內義軍配合，七月毛拉維·艾哈邁杜拉沙率義軍襲擊英軍師駐地得手，逼英軍退守；十一月坎貝爾以約兩千人、二十二門砲的救援縱隊突入城內解圍，翌年三月休·羅斯以攻城砲列攻破凱撒巴格。英軍的後勤靠鐵路、牛車隊與恒河船運維持，沿線電報線屢遭切斷，叛軍的彈藥卻只能靠繳獲，這一條差距決定了整場戰爭的走勢。
tacticsEn: The rebel tactics carry the mark of a barracks rising: disarm friendly units, seize the magazines and powder stores, then march in column on British posts. The Meerut mutineers covered some forty kilometres day and night and reached Delhi on the eleventh, at once assaulting the gates, the Red Fort and the arsenal. Holding the Red Fort, the rebels used the walls, ditches and old batteries to drive British cavalry out of the suburbs, but they could neither close the roads outside the city nor keep a supply line. The British answered with a siege: Delhi was invested on 8 June, batteries raised outside the walls, 24-pounders and 8- and 9-inch howitzers firing at the ramparts and at targets inside, traffic sealed off, the intention being to reduce the city by artillery and blockade. The rebels replied with field guns posted at Badli Bagh, one long-barrelled piece of which was recorded as striking a British battery at long range, though the gun and the range claimed for it are told differently in the two sides' official histories. Only on 14 September did the British go in with a main column, a second column and a third, clearing the narrow streets by linear fire, bayonet charge and house-to-house fighting, the assaulting force numbering about 3,700 men with more than 1,100 casualties on the attacking side. Cawnpore in July was the rebels' most successful gunnery surprise: on the fifth, night artillery fire broke up the entrenchment of seventy-four guns under Lieutenant-Colonel Wheeler, who recovered his position with cavalry support; the same formula was later used against Jhansi, where Hugh Rose's Central India Field Force reduced the walls with a siege train, the city falling in April when the gates were opened from within and the garrison collapsed. Lucknow showed a different pattern of defence: the Residency as a fortified core working with the volunteers inside the city, a blow by Moulvi Ahmadullah Shah's men against the British brigade camp in July that drove the British back into the Residency, Campbell's relief column of about 2,000 men and twenty-two guns entering the city on 23 November, and Hugh Rose's siege train battering Kaiserbagh in March the following year. British supply ran on railways, bullock carts and the Ganges, the telegraph line along the route being cut again and again, while rebel ammunition came only from what they captured, and that single difference shaped the whole war.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下：一八五七年五月印度境內的英籍部隊約四萬五千人，印度陸軍總兵力約十五萬人，其中孟加拉軍最為龐大；密拉特事發時，拒絕使用新式藥包的共八十五人，被判十年苦役的有二十九人，五月十日之後全營印度籍士兵集結起事，五月十一日進抵德里。六月六日阿拉哈巴德軍械庫淪陷，起義軍取走約八千支步槍、逾百門火炮與大量火藥，這批儲備後來供應了北方戰線數月的消耗。德里圍城自六月八日至九月十四日，前後近三個月；九月十四日攻城的縱隊合計約三千七百人，攻方傷亡逾一千一百人，其後英軍在城內肅清殘敵。坎伯而方面，惠勒少校在七月五日營中約有一千二百名可戰人員、兩千六百名隨營人員與七十四門砲。勒克瑙方面，十一月二十三日坎貝爾的救援縱隊約兩千人、二十二門砲。休·羅斯的中央印度野戰軍總兵力約一萬二千人，配備攻城砲列，於一八五八年四月攻克占西，該城守軍不足四千人。一八五七年至一八五八年英國自本土與中國遠東調入大批援軍，英籍部隊增至約七萬至八萬人。役後印度陸軍的英籍與印度籍比例由起義前約一比二調整為約二比一，炮兵兵種基本由英籍把持。戰役自一八五七年五月延續至一八五八年六月，其後零星抵抗延續到一八五九年，被捕的坦提亞·托佩於一八五九年四月處決。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In May 1857 there were about 45,000 European troops in India against a total Indian Army strength of roughly 150,000, Bengal being by far the largest; at Meerut eighty-five men refused the new cartridges and twenty-nine were sentenced to ten years' hard labour, and after 10 May the native troops of the cantonment rose en masse, reaching Delhi on the eleventh. On 6 June the Allahabad arsenal fell and the rebels carried off some eight thousand muskets, more than a hundred guns and much ammunition, stores that fed the northern front for months to come. The siege of Delhi ran from 8 June to 14 September, close to three months; the columns that stormed the city on 14 September numbered about 3,700 men and lost more than 1,100, after which the British swept up the remaining resistance. At Cawnpore Wheeler's camp on 5 July held about 1,200 combatants, 2,600 camp followers and seventy-four guns. At Lucknow Campbell's relief column on 23 November was about 2,000 men with twenty-two guns. Hugh Rose's Central India Field Force numbered about 12,000 men with a siege train and took Jhansi in April 1858, where the garrison numbered fewer than 4,000. Between 1857 and 1858 Britain sent large reinforcements from home and from the Far East, raising the European force in India to some 70,000 to 80,000. Afterwards the ratio of European to Indian troops in the Indian Army was turned from about one to two into about two to one, and artillery was kept almost entirely in European hands. The rising ran from May 1857 to June 1858, with scattered resistance continuing into 1859, when Tantia Tope was taken and executed in April.
cause: 起義的成因是多層的，最外層是東印度公司對印度的經濟與軍事壟斷：公司獨佔鴉片與硝石生意，控制紡織品與食鹽貿易，以田賦承包制把農民收入抽走；英國自一八四〇年代起推行吞併政策，凡無男嗣或無合格繼承人的土邦領地被收回，達爾豪、薩塔拉、占西、那格浦爾先後落入公司之手，一八五六年更以治理不善為由吞併奧德，把一個仍有軍隊、有議會、有獨立司法的土邦王國變成省份，直接觸怒了奧德的印度教地主與伊斯蘭貴族。次一層是軍隊與社會的裂痕：孟加拉軍的蘇巴達多出身鄉村中產家庭，卻被限制在副官以下，薪資與津貼低於同級英籍兵，軍中又把跨越河流、出洋作戰、替英籍軍官服務等安排視為常規，觸犯宗教禁忌；而一八五七年起換發的恩菲爾德新式藥包以牛脂密封，軍中謠傳摻入豬油，儘管沒有實據，咬下新藥包便要喪失教籍的說法仍在一月間傳遍各營，成為最有效的動員話術。深一層是邊疆部族與徵稅的衝突，以及馬德拉斯軍、孟買軍中部分印度籍士兵的不安。這些壓力同時作用在同一批人身上：他們既是士兵，也是被公司徵稅、被公司徵召、被公司歧視的本地社會成員。
causeEn: The causes were layered. The outermost was the Company's economic and military monopoly: a state monopoly on opium and saltpetre, control of the textile and salt trades, and revenue farming that took the farmer's income; from the 1840s Britain pursued annexation, taking over the estates of princes without male heirs or acceptable successors, Dalhau, Satara, Jhansi and Nagpur in turn, and in 1856 annexed Awadh on the ground of misgovernment, reducing a kingdom that still had an army, an assembly and independent courts to a province, which enraged Awadh's Hindu landowners and Muslim nobility alike. Below that lay the gap between army and society: Bengal's subedars mostly came from rural middle families yet were capped at subedar and were paid less than British equivalents, and the army's routine arrangements, crossing rivers, serving overseas, performing service for English officers, ran against religious taboo; and the new Enfield cartridges introduced from 1857 were sealed with grease, with rumours in the ranks that it was pig fat, untrue as that was, the belief that biting the new cartridge meant losing one's religion swept the cantonments within a single January and became the most effective instrument of mobilisation. Deeper still were the conflicts of the frontier and of revenue collection, and the disaffection of some Indian soldiers in the Madras and Bombay armies. All these pressures fell on the same men, who were soldiers and at the same time members of the local society taxed, conscripted and discriminated against by the Company.
impact: 起義的直接後果是統治結構的重寫。一八五八年八月《印度議會法案》廢除東印度公司的行政權力，英王在位政府於同年十一月一日接管印度，坎寧成為首任總督，總督改由英王任命並只對議會負責；總督府先設於加爾各答，直到一九一一年才正式遷往新德里，此後印度的政治中心落定。軍隊同樣被拆骨重組：英籍與印度籍比例由約一比二調為約二比一，炮兵兵種長期只許英籍擔任，線膛槍逐步統一，宗教禁忌被逐項協商式地放寬，加薪與津貼提高，一八六一年的刑法與一八六七年的三軍合併把制度重新排好次序。同時地方王公的世襲土地、封號與司法權被進一步剝奪，奧德、占西等相繼併入直轄省，英國改以土邦代理人統治印度。思想上，這場起義被後世民族主義者視為第一次大規模的獨立戰爭，寫進從一八五七年到一九四七年的一條連續敘事，一八五七年這個年份在印度政治記憶中的地位，等同於英國人記憶中的特拉法加與滑鐵盧。對英國而言，它同時把印度變成帝國的核心防區：孟買海軍陸戰隊、旁遮普騎兵團等團隊成為常備力量，之後隨英軍遠征埃及與蘇丹；而印度的財政、兵源與英國本土的改革辯論、乃至與俄國的角力，都從此綁在一起。
impactEn: The direct consequence was a rewriting of the structure of rule. The Indian Councils Act of August 1858 stripped the East India Company of its governing powers; the Crown government took over India on 1 November that year, Canning became the first Governor-General under the new order, and the office was henceforth filled by Crown appointment and answerable to Parliament. The seat of government was at first in Calcutta and was not formally moved to Delhi until 1911, but the political centre of India was settled from that point. The army was likewise taken apart and rebuilt: the European-to-Indian ratio moved from about one to two to about two to one, artillery was kept in European hands for decades, rifled muskets were standardised, religious prohibitions were relaxed piecemeal through negotiation, pay and allowances rose, and the 1861 penal code and the 1867 union of the three Presidency armies put the institutions back in order. At the same time the princes lost hereditary land, titles and jurisdiction, Awadh and Jhansi were absorbed into directly ruled provinces, and Britain came to rule India through princely agents. In thought, later nationalists would treat the rising as the first great war of independence, placing it in a continuous line running from 1857 to 1947; the year 1857 occupies in Indian political memory a place analogous to Trafalgar and Waterloo in British memory. For Britain it also made India the core of the imperial defence: the Bombay Marine's sepoys and the Punjab cavalry became standing formations and campaigned later in Egypt and the Sudan; and India's finances, its manpower, the reform debates at home and the rivalry with Russia were all bound together from that point on.
result: 起義最終失敗，失敗的過程本身就是結果。叛軍在德里陷落後退往北方，勒克瑙的守軍在解圍後耗盡，坎伯而與占西相繼淪陷，昆瓦爾·辛格於一八五八年十一月十八日傷重去世，拉尼·拉克什米拜於同年六月十八日在科塔赫塞賴一帶陣亡，坦提亞·托佩率殘部游擊至一八五九年四月被捕，於沙普爾絞死；巴合杜爾沙在紅城失守後退往胡馬雍陵一帶，被英軍搜索隊擒獲，押往仰光，於一八六二年在流放地去世。戰敗的癥結不在火力而在組織：起義沒有常設的指揮中心，沒有統一的戰役計畫，沒有把北方幾個起義點連成一片的補給網，彈藥靠繳獲而英軍靠海運與鐵路，兩邊的消耗能力從一八五七年秋天起就已經拉開；南方與西部的軍隊多數沒有跟隨，叛軍也始終沒有能力在英國本土捲入兵力之前切斷德里的補給線。一八五八年六月二日英方公布女王宣言，承諾既往不咎並保護宗教習俗，試圖在叛軍內部製造分歧，此舉在北方收效有限。於是結局是：東印度公司統治終結，印度進入王室直轄時代，英軍在印度的常駐從此固定到一九四七年；與此同時，一八五七年留下的火藥、榮譽與創傷，成為之後每一代印度人反覆引用的政治資源。
resultEn: The rising failed, and the manner of its failure is itself the result. Driven from Delhi, the rebels fell back north; the garrison at Lucknow was exhausted after the relief; Cawnpore and Jhansi fell in turn; Kunwar Singh died of his wounds on 18 November 1858; Rani Lakshmibai was killed near Kotah-ki-Serai on 18 June that year; Tantia Tope carried on raiding until his capture in April 1859 and was hanged at Shapoor; and Bahadur Shah, who had withdrawn from the Red Fort towards Humayun's Tomb after the city fell, was picked up by a searching party and taken to Rangoon, where he died in exile in 1862. The defect was organisational, not one of firepower: the rising had no permanent command centre, no unified plan of campaign and no supply network tying the northern points of revolt together; ammunition came from plunder while the British drew theirs by sea and rail, and from the autumn of 1857 the difference in endurance was already widening. Most units in the south and west did not join, and the rebels never managed to cut the British line of supply to Delhi before reinforcements could be shipped in from Britain. On 2 June 1858 the British issued the Queen's proclamation, promising no punishment for the past and protection of religious custom, an attempt to breed dissension inside the rebel ranks that had limited effect in the north. The upshot was that Company rule ended, India entered the era of direct Crown rule, and the British military presence in India was fixed in place until 1947. At the same time the gunpowder, the honour and the wounds of 1857 became a political resource invoked again and again by every later generation of Indians.
